text:
I’m passionate about building reliable, user-friendly web apps and I’d love to help with this project.

With 7 years of experience in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, I can build a responsive website that handles draw entries, automated email/SMS responses, and ticket delivery while keeping the system organized and secure.

I recently built a ticket shop with interactive seat maps for Northlight Events using Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Stripe. It held seats for 8 minutes during checkout and sold 18k tickets on opening night with zero double-booked seats.

I also have experience working on full-stack flows that involve payments, membership-style logic, and automated messaging, so I can structure the wallet and reward-point system clearly.

Would you like the membership credits and draw wallet to be updated through a manual admin flow, or fully automated through the payment process?
